facts.text: The Paraguay River separates the eastern region from the western Chaco.

culture.text: Spanish and Guaraní coexist in daily life, including the mixed speech known as Jopara.

food.name: Chipa
food.text: This bread is commonly made with manioc flour and traditionally baked in an outdoor oven.
